filters.predicate: runs/human/working-memory-nback/run-*.json
drop phase == 'practice' and blocks named training-*
level read from the block name ('2-back'), because payload level is null in 4 of the 57 records
drop the first n trials of each block (lead-in: no letter n back, and 112 of those 318 trials are nonetheless logged target=true)
target recomputed as letter[i] == letter[i-n]; agrees with the logged flag on 1908/1908 of these trials
granularity: one cell per (participant, level), NOT pooled over a participant's three levels
lure = non-target whose letter matches at lag n-1 or n+1

unit.fa_rate: P(respond same | non-target), over answered non-target trials
unit.miss_rate: P(respond different | target), over answered target trials
unit.position_thirds: accuracy over answered trials in each third of the block
unit.ratio: miss_rate / fa_rate, dimensionless (random responding -> 1.0); withheld below 30 false alarms and to be read only alongside ratio_ci_over_cells
unit.unanswered_rate: share of defined trials with no parseable label

M4_word_recognition_lag.caveat: all test words are visible in one list and 'Old' means 'appeared earlier in this list', so this curve measures list inspection as well as memory

M4_word_recognition_lag.unit: accuracy on old trials (proportion correct) within a lag bin
